recentItems.title: Cockroach milk, nose-blowing research win Ig Nobel Prizes
recentItems.description:
Ten research teams were honored Thursday at a satirical science awards ceremony that was hosted outside the U.S. for the first time due to travel concerns.

recentItems.title: Russia to close German cultural centers over Europe’s support for Ukraine
recentItems.description:
Russia says it will close German cultural centers on its territory in a retaliatory measure amid deepening tensions between Moscow and European countries who are helping Ukraine.
